games.name: DONGDA Gangster
games.summary:
About This Game
Immersed in the turbulent "Tohoku" underworld epicof the 1980s, "Northeast Past" is a real-life interactivevideo game that combines hardcore underworldsurvival rules with multi-branching narratives, takingyou to experience the underworld and get involved inthe bloody fate of gang disputes.

A Star-Studded Team for an Authentic Adaptation
Directed by Kong Ergou, the original author of the novel, the game stays true to the core of the beloved storyline. Di Huangjin, a renowned interactive movie game producer, oversees the entire gameplay experience from concept to release. The original star cast of the IP also returns for this adaptation. While preserving the IP’s iconic essence, we’ve crafted a fresh take on the story, delivering cinematic live-action interactive gameplay that captures the unadulterated spirit of the Northeast underworld and a one-of-a-kind brand of Eastern heroic fervor.

An Iconic IP – Live the Underworld Legend Yourself
The original novel has sold over 40 million copies, and its live-action adaptation is a Douban classic with an 8.8/10 rating! This time, you’re no longer a bystander to the legend—you forge and write your own 20 years of fiery heroism. Step into the Northeast underworld of the 80s and 90s, and make pivotal choices that could either ignite a blazing legacy or lead to total ruin, amid the fire and frost of a transformative era.

Your Choices Shape the Underworld
Play as Zhao Hongbing and navigate the twists and turns of a life of chaos and courage, making choices that split the story into distinct paths at every turn. Stand by your brothers through thick and thin without hesitation, or swallow your pride and endure humiliation just to survive—every decision unlocks a radically different story branch. Will you become a legendary underworld lord? Or will your fiery life burn out too soon, a tragic ballad cut short? Unlock a host of epic, high-stakes endings as you carve your path.

Immersive Era, Meticulous Detail
With top-tier artistic craftsmanship, the game recreates an era where passion and courage ran through every street. From rusted old factory districts to neon-drenched nightclubs, every scene is steeped in the raw, unfiltered energy of 1980s and 90s Northeast China.

Dynamic Relationships, a Vivid Cast of Characters
Every encounter with the classic characters from the live-action series is a collision of fates, forging unbreakable bonds of brotherhood and heroism. The game’s Archive System delves deep into every character’s backstory, breathing life and humanity into them. Uncover hidden character arcs rife with loyalty, betrayal, and unspoken friendship—each one a new layer to the underworld’s rich tapestry.

As you explore, use your camera to observe animal behavior and expand your personal wildlife lexicon. From elusive wolves and majestic eagles to mischievous raccoons, each species adds life to the park’s biological habitat.

You will work hard at various jobs such as guiding guests and cleaning, adding new facilities and making it a wonderful hot spring inn.

Use the coins that guests earn by using the facilities to open shops, game corners, and more to develop the inn. The more facilities you add and the higher your level, the more coins you earn, and the more facilities you can open! You can enjoy the excitement of expanding your possibilities and the sense of accomplishment as your inn becomes more lively.

This game offers endless fun and replayability. In this game, you'll experience the satisfaction of gradually expanding a quiet hot spring inn into a vibrant place, while enjoying a relaxing hot spring life with the comical and adorable Sumikko characters.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance + Online

Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure through space and time! 

Herbert Fink, a young scientist, faces difficult yet fascinating challenges. An ordinary trip out of town turns into a real investigation, full of intrigue and mysterious temporal anomalies!

Colorful scenery, animation, and 3D visual effects will make your adventure vivid and fun. Those with a competitive streak can collect bonuses for speed and repeat the quest with new puzzles

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary:
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is the brutal and fast-paced sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun.

Following directly on from the end of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, your duty takes you to new locations in a branching, single-player campaign that effortlessly blends the grimdark Warhammer 40,000 universe with a fast-paced first-person shooter.

Take the fight to never-before-seen worlds and vanquish the foes that lurk there. From the colossal heights of a hive city to the impenetrable mangrove swamps of a jungle, you’ll need to overcome the challenges of each biome to complete your mission.

games.name: いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -
Tanks Sweet Tanks
games.summary:
It’s fast. It’s fun. It’s addicting. 

Deafest the enemy tanks while dodging their deadly bullets. 
Improve your aim and maneuver skill while war itself is trying to end your adventure. 
Level by level the enemy's tanks get faster, smarter, and deadlier. 
Can you make it to the end and defeat their leader? 

Play alone. Play with your friends. Play against your friends. 

- Play the single-player campaign to practice your skills and beat the game by yourself. 
- Finish the campaign with 2 players in the co-op mode. 
- Defeat your friends in the VS Mode for up to 4 players.

games.name: Final Kick Football Legends
games.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

games.name: The Spotter: Dig or Die
games.summary: Dig by day, fight by night in this blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message and humanity’s last hope.

games.name: Gothic 3
games.summary: You have saved the island Khorinis from the forces of evil in Gothic I and Gothic II. Now it is time to travel to the realms of the mainland. Invading Orcs have enslaved the human kingdom. There are but a few free humans in the icy north and the southern desert and a handful of rebels hiding in the forests and mountains of Midland. You may either join the rebellion or serve the Orcish Usurpers but you will ultimately tip the scales and decide the outcome of the last war to save humanity. There is no simple linear story in Gothic III - every game will be different and unique - but all will ultimately lead to you deciding the fate of Myrtana.

games.name: Storage Hunter Simulator
games.summary:
Step up to the challenge and take a risk in the world of Storage Hunter Simulator, where you'll compete against others for the ultimate prize - garages filled with hidden treasures waiting to be discovered! In this exciting game, you'll have the chance to showcase your skills and become a giant of the storage market!

In this simulation game, you'll need to master the art of auctions, selling valuable items to wealthy collectors, and improving your skills as an appraiser to stay ahead of the competition. But that's just the beginning - the storage empire is waiting for you!

games.name: Sunstone of Time
games.summary:
Step into the role of a brilliant young scientist whose fascination with ancient relics leads to an unexpected journey through history. Sunstone of Time is a historical VR odyssey where exploration, secret discovery, and intricate puzzle-solving are your keys to survival in the vibrant world of the Aztecs, and your only hope of returning home!

After a groundbreaking experiment goes awry, you awaken in a distant past, thrust into an unfamiliar era. Explore breathtaking temples, ancient settlements, and sacred sites. Piece together forgotten knowledge, interact with a vibrant world, and meet unique characters, each with their own stories and motives. But danger lurks in the shadows: a powerful high priest is weaving dark schemes that threaten not only your fate, but the future of the entire world. Only your intelligence, courage, and insatiable curiosity can guide you through this ancient labyrinth of challenges.

Unravel a rich and engaging story as every step brings you closer to understanding Aztec culture and uncovering the path back to your own time. Will you rise to the challenge, reshape your destiny, and save the world?

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary:
A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. 

This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

games.name: MANIC MINER
games.summary:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! 

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Station to Station
games.summary: Station to Station’is a minimalist & relaxing game about building railway connections. Grab your conductor’s hat and bring the voxel-art world to life through the magic of trains!

games.name: GRIME II
games.summary:
Become a stealer of forms in GRIME II, the sequel to 2021's acclaimed action-adventure Metroidvania. You are a Formless - an art mimic, absorbing creatures and summoning molds in their shape.

Venture into a new and mysterious land in the GRIME universe, where danger and wonder await around every corner. Use your surroundings in tandem with your summoned molds to overcome deadly enemies and epic bosses, all the while exploring a deep world full of diverse cultures and characters.

Create your own playstyle by choosing from a variety of abilities, weapons, and mold summons. Learn the makings of your enemies as you summon their form to both aid you in combat, as well as in exploring the various secrets paths of the world.

games.name: MR. ELEVATOR
games.summary: Hello, I'm Mr. Elevator. Are you seeking a bizarre puzzle game? If you want a game where five people in an elevator explore a strange world drawn like early Windows Paint, listening to odd symbols and sounds to solve mysteries and descend to the deep floors, this is it.

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told - learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

games.name: Danger Mouse
games.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3
games.summary:
Introducing the Trilogy Box, a set of three packaged versions of the "Senjou no Fuga" series and luxurious goods!

The long-awaited package version of the trilogy of the dramatic simulation RPG "Fuga of the Battlefield" series with the themes of war, revenge, and beasts is now available!

The Nintendo Switch package, Taranis Metal Figure, art book, and soundtrack will be delivered in a special box.

games.name: GrimKeep
games.summary:
The city is lost. From the castle at its center an evil spreads, changing everyone into wretched parodies of life. Desolate streets infested with monsters, perpetually dark skies threaten to spread across the land.

Be the hero, reach the GrimKeep and end the source of evil; the Princess.

In a world of fairy tales turned nightmares, GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder that challenges you to master both luck and strategy. Collect powerful relics, forge unstoppable synergies, and battle through a city consumed by darkness.

games.name: Silly Polly Beast
games.summary: An otherworldly, story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. This is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, she was forced to study its nature. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

games.name: Treachery in Beatdown City: Ultra Remix
games.summary: Treachery in Beatdown City: ULTRA REMIX is a massive story and content update for Treachery in Beatdown City! Tripling the content, Ultra Remix adds new levels, lots of new exciting attacks, defense options, ~80 more enemies to fight, new music, and more!

games.name: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
games.summary:
Winx Club – Moonlight Quest is a brand-new video game adventure that allows players to experience the magical universe of Winx Club through exploration, flight, action and a wide variety of mini-games.

Take control of Bloom, transform at will, explore iconic locations from the ground and the skies, master magical powers and uncover the secrets surrounding the mysterious Festival of the 100 Moons.

Alongside the main adventure, players can enjoy 32 mini-games across four game modes and play as 24 characters from the Winx Club universe.

games.name: Dune: Awakening - Blood and Ice
games.summary:
The Polar Sink map features two distinct biomes: the tundra and the ice cap. Players begin in the tundra, where wealthy water shipper families defend their lavish strongholds. Beyond lies the heavily guarded ice cap, where securing access to ice becomes a central goal.

Equipment built for the desert heat will need upgrading to withstand the cold. With the action returning to the ground, traversal, temperature management, and combat become essential to progression. Resources found only in the Polar Sink will allow players to craft the gear they need to survive.

The new map offers around 35 hours of progression, with opportunities to return for valuable resources. Harvested ice can cool base equipment and speed up production, while the free expansion also introduces new vehicle modules, augments, and specialization traits. Future updates will add further reasons to revisit the region.

games.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.summary:
Get ready for a cozy journey in "Hela", where you'll step into the tiny paws of a brave mouse, the beloved familiar of a witch who needs your help. 

Wander through an enchanting Scandinavian landscape filled with puzzles to solve, potions to brew, and quests to complete, all to aid your ailing witch. Whether you play alone or with friends, you're in for a treat filled with magic, companionship, and loads of charm.

"Hela" offers a delightful mix of adventure and relaxation. Enjoy exploring vast, open spaces, engaging in light-hearted play, and experiencing the simple pleasure of being a part of a caring community.

games.name: Plinko Plonko Plunko
games.summary:
Plinko Plonko Plunko is a collection of ball-based arcade games inspired by classic video games. Collide colored balls at the targets to earn Lips that open entry to coolest game of all - Ballceteria.

The aim of Plinko Plonko Plunko is to build up your collection of colored balls that you get to bliss out with in Ballceteria. Shoot, grab, dodge, and pray your way in the games to increase the number of balls in your collection.

Plinko Plonko Plunko is unapologetically bonkers, unbelievably British, and unashamedly tacky. Sometimes if you want something to exist you have to make it yourself.

games.name: Luma Island
games.summary:
Travel to Luma Island to go on an epic adventure by yourself or with your friends and family. 

Begin your extraordinary journey in a humble old caravan and rise to the grand achievement of building a majestic manor that you can proudly call your home.

Traverse the island solving quests and helping the locals through their struggles. Dangerous spider caves, ancient temples, mind-bending puzzles and hidden treasures await you!

Pick from seven unique in-depth professions each with its own progression path. Upgrade your tools to gather rare materials and collaborate with your teammates to become the masters of your crafts.

games.name: The Ascent: Ultimate Edition
games.summary:
The Ascent is a solo and co-op Action-shooter RPG set in a cyberpunk world. 

You play as a worker enslaved by The Ascent Group, a corporate-run metropolis stretching high into the sky and filled with creatures from all over the galaxy. You must take up arms and embark on a new mission to find out what started it all.

games.name: The Falconeer: Revolution Remaster
games.summary:
Take flight in this remastered 'stick control era' aerial combat RPG. Explore haunting landscapes, engage in epic dogfights, and uncover ancient secrets in a visually enhanced, rebalanced edition of the BAFTA-nominated, award-winning original.

You take on the role of Falconeer, a powerful airborne warrior traversing a vast oceanic world torn apart by generations of poisonous decisions and dissent. Throughout multiple campaigns, you will experience life from many different perspectives and loyalties as you embark on a journey of discovery, and solve the mystery of the Ursee, its people and history.

Progress through perilous missions and side quests, wielding your lightning caster to protect ships against pirates, kraken and other threats. Dive through the deep ocean depths, soar above the clouds to do battle with giant crab cities or engage in furious dogfights against the mysterious Mancer Order that controls and regulates technology.

games.name: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
games.summary: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. Framed for murdering the Emperor, villainess Scarlet and Lily, fight the Empire as the first Streamers in history. Capture every enemy and turn them into allies for a happy ending... Or execute everyone and become the Demon Queen!

games.name: The Outer Worlds 2: Side Effects Guaranteed
Aeterna Lucis
games.summary:
Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania focused on fast-paced combat, exploration, and an engaging story. The sequel to Aeterna Noctis follows the steps of its predecessor including a brand new protagonist and a large interconnected world! 

After the events of the first game, the Queen of Light must stop the destruction of the very existence by challenging the Supreme God Chaos while seeking the location of their old nemesis.

games.name: Bloodrush: Undying Wish
games.summary:
Dash, shoot and strike in this lightning-paced hack n' slash roguelike set in a gothic, undying world!

Focused on movement abilities, split-second decision-making and stylish strings of attacks, Bloodrush encourages a creative approach to combat, combining abilities to demolish your foes!

Delve into Death's domain in multiple runs, unlocking the Stranger's vast arsenal of 6 weapons, 10+ combos, 20+ upgrades, and more.

Uncover insights into Death's imprisonment, progressively learning more of her captors' motivations and philosophies at every run.

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: E.S.D.E.
games.summary:
Humanity is on the brink of extinction. Most of the population has disappeared, and those who remain have transformed into strange, soulless anomalies creatures that were once human and have now become a terrifying, unknown threat.

Every expedition is a gamble.
One mistake could be your last.

In E.S.D.E., every expedition is a high-stakes gamble. Explore six different zones, from massive apartment complexes to an old school, and recover valuable items that you can sell to merchants to fund your next runs. Face seven types of anomalies, each with unique behaviors.
 
Every expedition puts you at risk, so stay alert. If something is lurking nearby, put on your mask quickly and make sure it doesn't spot you. You'll be on your own for most of your time in these dangerous zones.

Every threat looks different.
Learn to recognize them before it's too late.

Explore six distinct zones, recover valuable items,
and live to tell the tale.

Wearing your mask could be crucial to keeping certain anomalies from detecting you.

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary:
The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples - so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination - now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

But saving a world already doomed is no easy task. With the help of Ysoris, her unlikely mentor, and Kanta, shaman prince of a lost tribe, Eline must overcome the formidable adversaries standing in her way.

games.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
games.summary: Hello! Bouncy Bernard is a cute doggy that likes fun a lot. Puzzles is one of his favorite. However, this is not only about fun. He is very smart and is fond of discovering the world as well. He invites you to accompany him in doing this. Today he wants to be with you to discover striking representations of well-known racing cars and vehicles. There are Formula 1 car, motorcycles, NASCAR racing cars, rally cars, monster trucks, snowmobiles and water scooters. So, as you can see there is huge collection of objects to became familiar with and have fun in playing puzzles along with Bouncy Bernard. Don’t wait any longer! Main features: - Interactive puzzles parts for children aged 3+. - Three levels of difficulty (6 parts, 12 parts, 20 parts puzzles). - Beautiful and realistic 3D pictures that are created to both entertain and educate children. - Intuitive navigation. - Drag and drop puzzle pieces. Tap a piece to make it large, move into the place of destination and release. - Gray, faded picture background facilitating matching pieces. - Supporting sound effects. - Switch on / off music function.

games.name: Fall Up
games.summary:
Leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with the adorable Labi! Use a wide range of jumps and moves to traverse this colorful cartoon world, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots, and uncover its hidden secrets.

GAMEPLAY

Labi is all about powerful, precise jumps!

Installing a thruster module instead of a mobility module by mistake gave Labi the shortest yet most powerful legs of any robot. With those mighty legs, Labi can perform a Leg Launch and blast off like a cannonball, Stomp enemies with tremendous force, or spring off walls.

And it gets even better! Once Labi finds the Warp Ball, you can instantly teleport to wherever it lands. To overcome obstacles and solve puzzles, plan your route carefully and combine Running, Stomping, Dashing, and Double Jumping to find the best way forward. When danger strikes, Dash like a ninja and rely on your quick reflexes to dodge whatever comes your way.

GOALS

The core directive of Labi’s program: seek FREEDOM!

Collect Batteries scattered throughout each level. Some lie in plain sight along the main path, while others require a little extra exploration. At the end of each level, you will receive Gems based on the number of Batteries you collected. Gather enough Gems to unlock new areas.

Collect every Battery in a level to unlock its Time Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the level’s final Gem—a worthy prize for serious challengers!

games.name: FreeStyle Football 2
games.summary:
In FreeStyle Football 2, each of the 12 characters available at launch will feature unique skills that dramatically shape playstyles, whether it’s delivering lightning-fast passes, boosting teammates’ morale, or unleashing a power shot at the perfect moment. Every match is about teamwork, precise coordination, and tactical depth, with players controlling one character each in intense five-versus-five online battles.

The game will be available in multiple editions, including Basic, Premium, Deluxe, and Limited Club Edition, with monetization through a familiar console framework of Season Passes, downloadable content, and ongoing content updates.

games.name: House Flipper 2: Pets
games.summary:
Welcome to Puffin Isle! This slightly neglected region of Pinnacove seems in urgent need of a makeover. From charming villas to forgotten landmarks, these jobs are sure to surprise you! 

Meeting friends old and new, can you help them make this place a cozy haven for all animal lovers? Or will you focus on creating your own pet-centered houses for other players to enjoy?

Learn more about different breeds and species, observe them, and fulfill their needs to see them thrive. Let one of your cats or dogs accompany you during renovations and watch your friends pet them together in the co-op mode. Relax after a day of hard work by playing with your little companions and forge a bond that will last a lifetime.

games.name: Million Depth
games.summary: Craft original weapons and engage in strategic time-freezing battles as you dive into the million-floor deep underground world of this deep-diving action strategy game.

games.name: PowerWash Simulator 2: Barbie Pack
games.summary:
With Barbie, You Can Be Anything! 

Turns out, “anything” includes a PowerWasher Barbie. Step outside of the box and power wash your way through Malibu in this clean-up adventure spanning five levels. Spray away muck, revealing sparkling, pristine plastic beneath!

Show dirt who’s boss in a sleek new look that takes power dressing to a whole new level. Accessorize with a range of practical and chic tools and attachments that make cleaning up a dream. Trade in the pink convertible and take your new abseiling kit and scissor lift for a spin to help hunt dirt high and low.

Ever wanted to ride the DreamHouse elevator from the point of view of Barbie? Or chill by the fire in front of the Dream Camper? Now you can. Escape to the ideal destination where the only pressure is in the water, as you blast away dirt from five new levels teeming with Barbie playsets and accessories.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary:
Thirteen months after six young girls vanished in Sicily, a new clue reopens the nightmare. 

When a mysterious recording rekindles the hope that her daughter might still be alive, Susan, against all reason, decides to go to the place where everything seems to have begun: a decaying noble residence isolated on the slopes of Mount Etna and once owned by the Ashmann family.

What starts as a desperate search soon becomes a journey into terror, where family secrets, memory, and obsession intertwine. Susan finds herself drawn into a labyrinth of relentless stalkers, hidden symbols, and supernatural phenomena. As reality fractures and dark powers rise, every step brings her closer to the truth… and to a terror older than herself.

Created to captivate both newcomers and longtime fans of the Remothered saga, Red Nun’s Legacy blends classic survival horror, stealth, and psychological horror, introducing new mechanics centered on perception, hypnosis, and environmental manipulation.

games.name: SOMBRAS: negative frames
games.summary:
Shiomi Alterio, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, lives with her father in a quaint Japanese town after her parents’ recent divorce, far from the life in Europe she was forced to leave behind.

One night, Shiomi is engulfed by a dark dimension made of familiar streets, hungry shadows, and a cast of girls that look just like her...

Help Shiomi return home by taking pictures of unusual sights, surviving unsettling encounters, and reuniting every single fragment of her broken self.

games.name: STEP THEATER
games.summary:
An uplifting rhythm game where your steps bring stories to life.

Step Theater is a music-and-rhythm game where you step to the beat to bring each “film” to life.

With every step, the story begins to unfold, the stage comes alive with color, and each film takes shape. As you progress, Step Theater gradually regains its buzz, and new films begin their run.

Each film offers a unique world and style, from tales of school life to side-scrolling-game-inspired stages. The music, backgrounds, characters, and actions all change from stage to stage, keeping every play session fresh.

Adorable characters in motion, catchy original songs, and stories brought to life by your own steps.

With your steps, make the theatre light and lively again.

games.name: The Dark Queen of Mortholme
games.summary: You are the final boss, the Dark Queen of Mortholme, unrivaled in power. A hero invades and is easily crushed. Yet, they keep returning. A short-form indie game about an unusual bond, perspectives, and the beauty of change.

games.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.summary:
Play as Garrett, an orphan rescued from the streets by the Keepers—a secretive, ancient order dedicated to maintaining balance in the world - and trained to become a Master Thief. Using minimal weapons and maximum stealth, you must keep to the shadows and move quietly to complete missions and collect treasure without too many casualties. 

In Thief: The Dark Project Remastered, Nightdive Studios brings back the pioneering 3D stealth game from Looking Glass Studios. Described by its developers as a “first-person sneaker,” the 1998 title challenged norms with its non-confrontational gameplay at a time when most first-person games prioritized combat. 

Remastered with Nightdive’s KEX Engine, the release includes Thief: The Dark Project and the additional missions, content and updates from the 1999 Thief Gold re-release. Explore unscripted, maze-like levels with advanced NPCs, who can hear, speak, and sound alarms if you make a wrong move. Each mission includes 3 difficulty settings with different objectives for maximum replayability.

games.name: Waltz and Jam
games.summary: Waltz and Jam is an action-adventure platformer following the adventures of Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion. It is set in an afterlife born from a unique reimagination of the Seven Deadly Sins.

games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 3
games.summary:
"Fighting to liveand living to fight" - A brand new RPG adventure awaits in Xenoblade Chronicles 3. Bringing together the futures of Xenoblade Chronicles and Xenoblade Chronicles 2, this title will take players to the world of Aionios, home to two hostile nations.  Keves: a nation where mechanical technology was developed. Their armies are composed of units consisting mainly of combat vehicles. They use units of small, mobile weapons operated by soldiers riding them. 

Agnus: a nation strong in ether, a magical technology. Their forces are built around units that specialise in ether combat, and they fight with small, mobile, autonomous weapons that use ether technology. 

Six soldiers hailing from these nations, will take part in a grand tale with life as its central theme. 

Noah: One of the protagonists of Xenoblade Chronicles 3 and a solider of Keves. Noah is also an "off-seer" who mourns for soldiers who've lost their lives on the battlefield. 

Lanz: An ally of Noah's who wields a great sword that doubles as a shield. 

Eunie: A childhood friend of Noah and Lanz who has a sharp tongue and rough personality. She specialises in healing her allies in battle. 

Mio: The other protagonist of this story, Mio is a soldier of Agnus and an off-seer like Noah. 

Taion: A tactician who fights alongside Mio using his smarts and insight. 

Sena: This soldier is an ally of Mio and Taion. Despite her petite figure, Sena wields immense physical strength!

games.name: Zero Hour
games.summary:
Zero Hour is a tactical FPS with online team-based game play that takes place in a variety of fictional locations interpreted in Bangladesh with Real-life scale & resource management. It brings a grounded, close quarter combat experience to the game.

Zero Hour brings a very grounded CO-OP, 5v5, team vs team, Close quarter combat experience to the game that focuses on two teams with each player having their own roles. The attackers utilizing shields, weapons and the planning table and the terrorists utilizing traps and gadgets in order to fortify the area. With CO-OP game mode will allow you to play bigger operations that you can either tackle solo or with a team of 5.

games.name: Aery - Four Seasons
games.summary:
Aery – Four Seasons is a relaxing, story-driven flight exploration game that carries you through a living world as it turns slowly from one season into the next. You play as a tiny bird-shaped spirit, drifting endlessly forward as the land beneath you blossoms, ripens, fades, and freezes — a full year unfolding one wingbeat at a time.

Begin in the first breath of spring, gliding over orchards heavy with pink and white blossom as meltwater trickles down from the last patches of snow and everything reaches greedily for the light. Drift into the long golden afternoons of summer, where wildflower meadows ripple in the warm air, still lakes mirror the sky, and fireflies begin to glow as the day softens toward dusk. Soar through the amber and crimson forests of autumn, leaves spiraling loose around you and mist gathering in the valleys as great flocks gather to move on. And finally, settle into the deep hush of winter — frozen lakes, bare silver trees, and a night sky rippling with quiet color over the snow.

Each season is its own self-contained world: a unique color palette, atmosphere, and mood that tells a different piece of a larger, quietly unfolding story. Hidden across every landscape are glowing memory fragments — scattered clues to the life this world holds through its endless turning. Collect enough of them and the season shifts, carrying you gently into the next.

Aery – Four Seasons is designed above all else to feel good. The flying is smooth and freeing, the world is warm and beautiful, and the story unfolds gently without ever demanding anything of you. Whether you play to explore, to collect, or simply to get lost somewhere peaceful, there is always something new waiting just beyond the changing horizon

games.name: House Flipper 2 + Sakura DLC
games.summary:
Clean your worries away with this relaxing renovation simulator! Buy, fix, sell, and become a local legend. Or grab your power tools and build anything from scratch! With the online 2-4 players co-op mode, you can play both in sandbox and story mode together.

Spring has arrived, and the view is stunning! Now you can celebrate the sakura blossoms all year long with a whole range of beautiful, distinct items inspired by Japanese culture. From classic paper walls to Japandi furniture, from traditional painting and ceramics to smart bathrooms… 

This is your chance to have fun with new architectural styles or relax while designing a perfect zen garden!

games.name: James Pond Legacy: The Pond is Not Enough
games.summary:
The James Pond series of games is one of the most beloved and successful franchises from the 80’s & 90’s. Known for its innovative gameplay, memorable graphics, atmospheric music and blockbusting reviews, the series captivated gamers the world over and set a new standard for platform games.

This collection brings together the entire James Pond series of C64 versions along with Amiga 500, Sega Megadrive/Genesis and SNES, where available, for the first time... James Pond: Underwater Agent, James Pond: Codename RoboCod, James Pond 3: Operation StarFish and James Pond: Aquatic Games!

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
games.summary:
The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality. Fulfill your duty as a Hunter by tracking and defeating powerful monsters and forging strong new weapons and armor from the materials you harvest from your hunt as you uncover the connection between the people of the Forbidden Lands and the locales they inhabit. The ultimate hunting experience awaits you in Monster Hunter Wilds.

A few years past, a young boy named Nata was rescued at the border of the Forbidden Lands, an unexplored region the guild has yet to survey.
After hearing the boy’s tale of his lone escape from a mysterious monster that attacked his village, the Guild organized an expedition into the Forbidden Lands to investigate.

A Living World

Environments within the Forbidden Lands can drastically change as the weather shifts constantly and suddenly. During the harsh Fallow and perilous Inclemency periods, ravenous monsters will venture out to hunt in packs, yet during the Plenty periods, wildlife is rich and abundant.

Monsters

The monsters who inhabit these environments have been forced to adapt to the dynamic changes that occur, using their unique characteristics to survive and thrive.

Hunting

As the world around them changes, so must the hunters and their tactics. Not only will hunters have a multitude of weapons and armor to choose from, but the art of the hunt itself has evolved as hunters learn to anticipate monsters’ behavior and familiarize themselves with their environment.

Characters

From hunting partners to fellow expedition members, you’ll encounter plenty of those who will support you on your journey.

games.name: Petit Planet
games.summary:
In Petit Planet, a little planet all of your own is yours to shape.

Build a home, decorate your favorite nooks and crannies, and gently shape the land, coast, and sky into a place that feels truly yours. Spend your days farming, fishing, beachcombing, cooking, or simply wandering at your own pace with your fuzzy Neighbors by your side.

When curiosity calls, set sail across the Starsea to discover uncharted places, new creatures, materials, recipes, and surprises waiting among the stars. You can also visit the Galactic Bazaar, a lively hub where galactic travelers come together to trade, have fun, create, and meet new friends.

Beneath a vast, starry sky, even the smallest idea can be part of the life you build.

games.name: Mouse Work
games.summary:
Quit mousin' around and get yourselves down to the job centre! Team up with friends or go it alone, facing a range of mini game challenges using the Switch 2 mouse controls. Each job features a unique and inventive mechanic making full use of the Joy-Con 2’s brand new cursor functionality.

In Mouse Work players take on the role of adorable mice that are just trying to earn some Cheddar. Fortunately for them, the local job centre has a wealth of offerings available, each testing our mice with new and innovative cursor-based gameplay. 

Whilst the whole game can be played solo, all the jobs are dialled up a notch when playing in local 2-4 player couch co-op mode. Multiplayer brings the party with a range of new challenges added to every job.

games.name: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey
games.summary:
Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a third-person open world survival game where you Explore, Expand, and Evolve to advance your clan to the next generation in this exhilarating new adventure from the creator of Assassin's Creed.

Embark on the most incredible odyssey known to humankind: human evolution. Spanning from 10 million to 2 million years ago, begin your journey, before us, in Neogene period Africa. Explore a beautiful yet ruthless world, from swinging through tree branches in the jungle to stalking prey across the golden savannah grasslands. Decide what attributes to learn and hone in order to pass down knowledge to future generations, from crafting tools to enhancing evasive tactics against predators. Just like real life, make sure to eat, drink, and sleep to stay alive and have the energy to face any danger that may come your way.

Grow your clan and find strength in numbers as you progress through critical evolutionary stages of human evolution. Your choices will write your clan's story and determine if you can survive your evolution.

Key Features:

* Explore Ruthless Africa: Explore the never-before-experienced world of Neogene Africa starting 10 million years ago at the dawn of humankind. From the tops of tree canopies overlooking lush jungles to the golden grasslands of the savannah, traverse a beautiful yet unforgiving landscape. For every breath-taking view, beware of the weather, predators, and other dangers that threaten your survival.
* Expand Your Territory and Grow Your Clan: Increase your chances of survival by uniting new members of your species and giving birth to future generations. Control different clan members, form bonds to create families, and work together to intimidate predators during expeditions. Conquer fear as you explore unknown locations in order to expand your territory.
* Evolve Through Multiple Generations: See the physical and intellectual evolution of the first hominids as you explore, learn, and survive. Spanning from 10 million to 2 million years ago, play as one of the first hominids and evolve over the course of millions of years during key stages in human evolution. Make crucial discoveries and hone physical abilities that will be passed down to future generations such as Ardipithecus ramidus and Australopithecus.
* Choose How You Survive: Evolution was not written in stone. Your decisions shape how you will overcome obstacles, increase your species, and what knowledge will pass on to future generations. Focus on specific attributes or choose a more balanced approach to survival. Your clan's ability to survive will be directly impacted by your choices, making each player's experience unique.

games.name: Don't! Fret
games.summary:
You wake as Fret, a sentient guitar trapped at Harmonic Heights, a prestigious music school with a dark secret. Evade the enemies hunting you, use music to complete puzzles and uncover hidden memories that explain why you’re here.

Use stealth, logic and an evolving guitar tuner to survive long enough to piece together your past and escape the school.

games.name: Elements Destiny
games.summary:
Solitas is in danger!

Erika learns this from a mysterious stranger named Airic O 'Fory. He warns her and her future companions of another shadow crusade, an approaching threat that took countless lives in Solitas 24 years ago. Only the descendants of the clans of elements have the power to avert it - Descendants like Erika. And so she embarks on a journey into the unknown, which will lead her through all of Solitas and perhaps even beyond.

Join Erika on her mission! Find all those who have been chosen to walk this path with her and awaken their elemental powers. Not only do they open up unique possibilities in combat, they also help you to overcome various obstacles along the way. Defeat fearsome monsters, treacherous adversaries - and sometimes Erika's own fears.

games.name: Guns of Eschaton
games.summary:
The Old South is burning, but its legends are not quite (un)dead.

Guns of Eschaton is a first-person soulslike shooter set in an apocalyptic Western by legendary art director Viktor Antonov (Half-Life 2, Dishonored, Prey, Fallout 4, Wolfenstein: The New Order). It is a land of dust, blood, false saints, broken history, and occult horror - a wasteland where the road to salvation is narrow and paved with spent shells and bodies that remember your name.

You are almost ordinary: fragile, outmatched, and surrounded by a dying world full of monsters. However, you have everything you need to survive the horrors of the burning world: a Colt, the instincts of a killer, and the will to make it home, no matter how long the road becomes.

games.name: The Planet Crafter: Magnetaris
games.summary: The “Magnetaris” DLC takes you to an unknown planet, battered by electrical storms and strongly affected by magnetic fields. You will have to stabilize it using new technologies and machinery. Alone or with friends, explore these magnetic lands, unveil their secrets, and restore balance to this planet!

games.name: Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded
games.summary:
Throw, hit, and brawl! The legendary 90s arcade beat 'em up combining baseball and martial arts returns in HD! Packed with new characters, modes, stages, and music, plus up to 4-player co-op!

The righteous "League-Man" step up to retrieve the stolen Golden Baseball Statue from the Baseball Hall of Fame!

Chain together exhilarating combos with rapid button mashes, execute wild throw moves after grabbing opponents, and wipe out incoming enemies with flashy special moves triggered by a single button!

"Pink," who was only a support character in the original, makes a long-awaited debut as a playable character. Experience newly reborn action in brilliant Full HD!

games.name: Riders Republic
games.summary:
Jump into the Riders Republic massive multiplayer playground! Meet and compete with other players, and ride hard with an exciting range of activities such as bike, ski, snowboard, wingsuit and rocket wingsuit. Live out the rider's fantasy as you roam free in a huge, vibrant open world, always buzzing with other players around you. Immerse yourself in iconic American national parks including Bryce Canyon, Yosemite Valley, Mammoth Mountain... all mashed up for you to shred!

Squad up with your friends and compete in a wide range of multiplayer modes: feel the rush of downhill races, dominate maps in team vs team competitions, or give it your best shot in epic mass PvP races with more than 50 other players. Go all out. Join the madness!

games.name: Aeruta
games.summary: A bread revolution across the world now begins! Aeruta is a side-scrolling action game with a shop management twist, fight monsters for materials and use them to make breads, then finally make the deserted town popular again!

games.name: Attack on Titan 3
games.summary:
Experience the story from beginning to end in the definitive culmination of the Attack on Titan game series.

Engage in pulse-pounding battles against the Nine Titans - making their first appearance in the game series - and immerse yourself in brand-new story arcs. Iconic moments from previous titles have been completely reimagined to deliver a fresh experience, with the narrative carried all the way through to its dramatic climax.

The series’ signature omni-directional mobility action has evolved to the next level, offering the most exhilarating and stylish high-speed combat in the history of the Attack on Titan game series.

games.name: Picross S Climax
games.summary: The game includes 1,020 carefully selected puzzles from Picross S, Picross S2, Picross S3, Picross S4, Picross S5, Picross S6, Picross S7, Picross S8, and Picross S9. It also includes 40 new high-difficulty bonus puzzles for veteran players, unlockable by linking save data from any game in the Picross S series.

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.summary: Professor Layton is back to face new puzzles in PROFESSOR LAYTON and The New World of Steam! Coming to Nintendo Switch.

games.name: Stage Tour
games.summary:
Stage Tour is a new rhythm-action game featuring 90+ officially licensed songs spanning six decades, 180+ authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, 50+ bandmates, and new ways to play.

Play your way with Lead Guitar, Groove Guitar/Bass, Drums, Vocals, PC Keyboard or gamepad, including 4-Lane and 5-Lane Arcade Mode. Choose from Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert difficulties along with Expert Plus on Drums, and take the stage with the official lineup of Stage Tour hardware.

games.name: Sugardew Island
games.summary: In this cozy farming game, you have to run your own farm shop. Take care of your animals and your farm, sell your goods to the cute Forest Folk, upgrade the island and fulfill small orders from the Harmony Tree to fill the island with life again.

games.name: Brew & Dash
games.summary:
Jump, duck, speed up, and hit the brakes to test your reflexes as you dodge obstacles and enemies, collecting ingredients along the way to brew potions, unlock new powers, and push even further. Take on challenges across randomly selected maps in this fresh take on the genre!

Join Mimi, a little witch with a big adventure ahead, as she explores a magical mine filled with ingredients, mysteries, and danger in this exciting new twist on the genre!

Brew & Dash is a semi-endless runner where Mimi is on a quest to brew a mysterious potion. To succeed, she'll need to travel through diverse biomes, overcome countless challenges, and master her skills and magical potions along the way.

Features

5 Unique Biomes: Explore five distinctive biomes, each filled with personality and new dangers.

Customize Mimi and Her Mine Cart: Collect a variety of skins for the little witch and her trusty mine cart.

Brew Your Own Potions: Mix ingredients in different ways to create a variety of magical potions.

Day and Night Cycle: Experience the changing atmosphere as day turns to night.

games.name: Dome Keeper
games.summary:
Dome Romantik has grown to become Dome Keeper with beautiful updated pixel art, atmospheric music and sound and more of everything.

Defend your dome from wave after wave of hostile attacks in this roguelike survival miner. Use the time between each attack to dig beneath the surface in search of valuable resources. Use them carefully on powerful upgrades to help you stay alive and make it to the next world.

games.name: Silver Palace
games.summary:
Silver Palace is a brand-new ARPG set in a prosperous metropolis with a Victorian aesthetic. It features an engaging story, a delicate art style, distinctive characters, and a dynamic, action-oriented combat system. 

Players will play the role of a “Detective” and embark on an adventure with a diverse group of partners to defeat the unknown enemies and unravel the mysteries in Silvernia, an industrialized metropolis built on the power of Silverium.

As various factions - from corporate monopolies and underground syndicates to royal affiliates and cults - vie for control of Silverium, tensions rise across the city.

As they explore the city’s sprawling environments, they’ll dive into the scenes of crime, hunt for clues in the shadow, battle their enemies and in the process reveal more of the stories of Silvernia.

games.name: Haul Yeah!
games.summary: Load it, strap it, drive it. A colourful delivery-driving sandbox for one or two players. Stack real physics cargo, tighten the straps and haul it across a mountain county in split-screen co-op or solo. Build your business with better trucks, custom parts and bigger jobs.

games.name: SUNSOFT is Back! Retro Game Selection 2
games.summary:
The second installment of Sunsoft's Retro Game Selection series is here!
This collection brings together some of Sunsoft’s most memorable retro titles from the 1980s, from major hits to hidden gems known only to dedicated fans.

Use the newly added save and rewind features to finally beat that game you could never quite beat back then.
The collection also includes a Gallery Mode featuring a selection of rare material from the original games, including concept artwork, promotional flyers, and more. Much of which you won't find anywhere else!

【Included Titles】
Super Arabian
Sunsoft’s first home console game, released in 1985. In this action game, the hero sets out on a journey to rescue a kidnapped princess.
Defeat enemies as you make your way through the game and collect all the Magic Jars. Take out multiple enemies at once to transform into the invincible Super Arabian!

Ikki
The quirky action game that became beloved as a “so-bad-it’s-good” classic, featuring multiplayer for up to two players at the same time. Gonbe, a young farmer, can no longer endure the heavy taxes imposed on his village and finally rises up in rebellion. Collect all the gold coins and rice balls and capture the local magistrate! Ikki is forever!

The Mystery of Atlantis
One day, the mysterious island of Atlantis suddenly rises from the sea. The protagonist sets off for Atlantis Island in search of his missing master.
A high-difficulty action game featuring a whopping 100 stages. If you couldn’t beat it back then, use the save and rewind features and, this time, finally uncover the mystery of Atlantis!

Maharaja
An adventure RPG hidden gem from Sunsoft, released in 1989. One day, while traveling in India, you discover a mysterious wooden box that the king Maharaja has been searching for. This discovery draws you into a battle that will ultimately determine the fate of the world...

games.name: Ravenswatch
games.summary:
Ravenswatch is a top-down roguelike action game that combines intense real-time combat with deep gameplay and high replay value.

After the success of Curse of the Dead Gods, Passtech returns with a new formula and game experience that can be played solo or with up to four players in co-op.

To defeat the Nightmare and reach the final chapter, you will need a strong build, focus and excellent teamwork. Increase your fighting power in battles then face the level boss when you feel ready... or when you no longer have a choice.

games.name: Chemical mistake
games.summary:
The protagonist, Akechi, and the heroine, Tominaga, find themselves held captive in a prefabricated laboratory. 

Trapped in a facility filling with poison gas and under the watchful eyes of chemist suspects, they join forces to escape - but Akechi is suffering from temporary amnesia and cannot recall a crucial piece of information... What fate awaits Akechi?

A suspense-filled adventure with a linear storyline that keeps your heart pounding until the very end!

games.name: A Game About Digging A Hole Together
games.summary: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand.

games.name: Abiotic Factor - Entropic Break
games.summary:
Embark on a new tropical adventure, roaming sun-drenched seas and forgotten islands. 

Investigate the warped GATE Leaf Test Facility and surrounding isles, confronting a new breed of fanatics, digital disorder, far-flung anomalies, the Flesh Dimension, and much more in this world-crossing DLC expansion.

games.name: Age of Empires IV: Raiders of the North
games.summary:
A new force rises in this latest expansion to Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition! 

Two New Civilizations - Vikings and Scots, each with distinct systems and evolving playstyles, as well as new architecture, masteries, music and evolving language. 

Expanded Crucible Mode - Four new missions and deeper progression with Boons, Perks, Mutators, and Civilization-specific Talent Tracks  

Solo and two-player Co-op Crucible - Take on new and reimagined challenges alone or with a friend. 

Two New Biomes - Scottish Heathland and Tundra Summer shape the look and feel of the battlefield

games.name: Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection
games.summary: THE BREED IS BACK! Celebrate 35 years of Alien Breed with the definitive collection. Featuring 6 classic games, interactive archives, modern controls, visual enhancements, co-op multiplayer, Online Rush Mode and Horde Mode, bringing the complete sci-fi horror legacy back to your screens.

games.name: ALZARA: Radiant Echoes
games.summary:
Take control of four heroes as you embark on an epic journey inspired by classic JRPGs across the stunning world of ALZARA.

Harness the elemental magic of Kayla and her allies to battle the invading forces of Vedores. Share the magic to overcome puzzles and obstacles during your adventure.

Swap between heroes to combine elemental magic and unleash spectacular attacks. Make offerings to gain favors and summon Legends to defeat your enemies.

games.name: Anima Gate of Memories: I & II Remaster
games.summary:
Anima is a third-person action RPG that weaves together two fates - one of a legendary monster and a mysterious girl with no memory of her past, the other of an immortal soul cursed to wander the world forever.

Their existence will take an unexpected turn when they discover that all of them have been involved in something sinister, a war in the shadows in which they will have an involuntary leading role in opposing sides of the table.

Experience the original Anima: Gate of Memories and its companion story Anima: The Nameless Chronicles - both fully remastered with improved visuals and gameplay.

Explore a rich fantasy universe inspired by the Anima Beyond Fantasy tabletop RPG saga, filled with deep lore, fast-paced combat, and branching storylines shaped by your choices.

games.name: Astrolander
games.summary: Play a reimagining of platformers in the action-packed Astrolander. Join a curious robot on a roll named Feedback and an adventurous rocket powered sidekick named Haptic on their quest to save the Most Valuable Programs.

games.name: Baptiste
games.summary:
Devastated by a family tragedy, Sara and her son, Tom, seek a new start at Jagged Shore Cliff. However, their worst fear is waiting for them there. 

In their new and mysterious home, a dusty cabinet holds Baptiste, an unsettling doll accompanied by an ominous warning: “Never release this from its glass prison.” 

What ought to have been a shelter becomes the scene of a nightmare that defies all logic, putting their sanity and desire to survive to the test

games.name: Barbie Rewind
games.summary:
Decorate the DreamHouse through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games in this cozy and creative game. Barbie Rewind pulls you back in time through iconic eras of Barbie with stunning pixel art and retro style. Your bestie, Barbie, invites you into her world and entrusts you to update her DreamHouse with your unique style, using items from 65+ years of Barbie history.

Choose from three retro DreamHouse designs for your exterior facade, walls, and floors. You can even mix-and-match them from room to room. Style each room with a fabulous collection of furniture, decor, and accessories, inspired by real Barbie playsets throughout the decades. From a classic pink vanity to a ‘90s inflatable chair, make the DreamHouse unique to your style and creativity.

Barbie has also left you her game collection of 16 Barbie video games from 1991 through 2007. Titles include Barbie Pet Rescue, Barbie Horse Adventures: Blue Ribbon Race, and the never-before-released game, Barbie: Vacation Adventure. Play through the collection to complete additional quests and unlock more items.

games.name: Barkour
games.summary:
BARKOUR is a fast-paced action platformer with a stealthy twist, starring Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble.

Jump, sneak and fight your way through a spy adventure packed with action, canine chaos and delightfully absurd surprises.

games.name: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement
games.summary:
Set in a haunting world years before the events of Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night, Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement follows Leo and the fearless Black Wolves as they prepare to storm the cursed Ethereal Castle and confront the rising darkness. Under the command of Lord Theodore, the warriors face horrific beasts and the malevolent Demon Lord Elias in a brutal battle for humanity’s survival. 

With innovative combat mechanics, cinematic storytelling, and relentless boss encounters, Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement promises an intense, atmospheric journey into the heart of evil.

games.name: Bogdan's Cross
games.summary:
Embark on a journey of redemption as Bogdan, a former knight of the Templar Order, in this dark medieval fantasy action-adventure game. 

Explore a richly detailed world filled with danger and intrigue, uncover ancient secrets, and battle terrifying creatures as you strive to atone for your past sins and uncover the truth behind a mysterious curse. 

With immersive gameplay, stunning visuals, and a compelling story, this is a game that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish.

games.name: Bounty Sisters
games.summary: Bounty Sisters

games.name: BPM: Bitcrushed
games.summary:
BPM Bitcrushed is a roguelite, top-down dungeon crawler rhythm game that fuses the pulse-pounding action of BPM: BULLETS PER MINUTE with retro-inspired pixel art. Every move - whether shooting, jumping, or dodging - syncs to the beat, making rhythm as crucial as reflexes.  

As players explore procedurally generated dungeons, they’ll uncover a wide variety of powerful weapons, unique items, and rhythm-based abilities. 

Enemies attack in time with the music, turning every battle into a high-stakes dance of destruction. Feel the intensity rise as the beat drives both you and your foes in an immersive, music-fuelled combat experience. Plus, with the custom music feature, you can add your own tracks to the game and experience a whole new level of rhythm-driven chaos.

games.name: Broken Sword: The Smoking Mirror - Reforged
games.summary:
‘Broken Sword - The Smoking Mirror: Reforged’ is an extensively enhanced version of the multi-award winning, all-time classic game.

While investigating a ruthless drug gang, journalist Nico Collard unexpectedly comes across an ancient artifact. Little can she know that the ornately carved obsidian stone will lead her, and her adventuring companion George Stobbart, into a mysterious escapade of intrigue and deceit, in which they must overcome powerful forces and antagonists who will stop at nothing to fulfil their evil ambitions.

Torment and terror, sacrificial rituals, and bloody massacre is unearthed beneath a veil of Mayan mystery. Kidnap, stolen treasure, astronomy, and deadly drug baron are the least of the duo’s worries, as divine forces threaten to annihilate mankind! Nerve, cunning and guile are essential in order to conquer in this compelling adventure, guaranteed to leave you with an aching brain and a beating heart. Are you up to the challenge?

games.name: Building Relationships
games.summary:
Experience life as a house in this silly adventure game! 

Play as a building as you roll, jump, and wave-dash across a cozy island. Meet eligible structures, romance them, and experience a bizarre, yet oddly familiar story.. or go fishing instead (though we replaced fish with cars to make more sense)

games.name: CALX
games.summary:
CALX is an atmospheric 3D action adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

The game moves between stillness and frenzy. Silent moments give way to frantic fights in a rhythm like waves - contemplation, then action, then back again. Art and music work in tandem. The mesmerizing visuals shape the soundscape, and the music breathes life back into the art.

You are alone on Syro, but not lonely. A speck of dust in a vast, mysterious world. There's a quiet melancholy to wandering these forgotten places.

games.name: Castle Of Alchemists
games.summary:
Step into the shoes of the alchemically enhanced super soldier, Bellator, in this pulse-pounding tower defense and top-down action hybrid game. As the first of its kind, you are humanity's last hope against invaders trapped within the castle. 

Strategically set traps, build defensive towers, equip powerful weapons and gear, and reclaim the castle piece by piece in an epic battle for survival. Unlock new abilities, traps and weapons to aid you in your mission to save survivors and gather lost knowledge.

games.name: Cat Me If You Can
games.summary: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

games.name: Changer Seven
games.summary:
Dive into Changer Seven, an exhilarating 3D third-person action-adventure where fast-paced combat meets stunning visuals and a gripping narrative.

Lead a squad of super-powered teenagers in a tag-team/assist-based combat system to battle hordes of enemies and uncover the dark mysteries surrounding their legacy. As you fight to save humanity, you’ll also face the personal struggles that come with being a hero and the changes your choices can bring to the future.

games.name: Cloudheim
games.summary:
Rally your allies for spectacular, combo-driven combat in a destructible world, where enemies take more damage when you use physics to destroy them. Harness powerful abilities and craft ever-evolving weapons to unlock new skills and devastating combos. Explore diverse islands and mysterious dungeons from your flying turtle base, Odin Shell. 

Play solo or in up to 4-player online co-op with a cast of characters and creatures to guide your journey. Cloudheim blends fast-paced action and dynamic crafting as you dive into a colorful fantasy realm waiting to be transformed.

games.name: Construction Simulator: Evolution
games.summary:
Dig into the next exciting evolution of the Construction Simulator series and experience the biggest construction playground ever. Control numerous licensed machines, take on manual labor, and master both construction and demolition.

Build your construction empire and expand your vehicle fleet to take on challenging construction contracts across two stunning maps - Maienstein (inspired by idyllic German landscapes) and Amber Falls (inspired by a Midwestern city in the United States).

Prepare yourself to master huge construction sites and satisfy your clients’ needs. Join forces with your friends in multiplayer and coordinate extensive tasks as you grow to become the biggest builder in town!

games.name: Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion
games.summary:
Production has been underway on Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion, an all-new entry and true sequel to the series. 

In a new setting, new horrors await with a cruel laugh. I hope that it will become a source of encouragement for those faced against the harsh realities of the world.

games.name: Cosmic Holidays
games.summary:
Somewhere in the galaxy, there is a world where everyone works endlessly. For its inhabitants, the Cibos, the great annual lottery is their only chance to escape this routine and win a week of vacation on a distant planet.

This year, Cibo is the lucky winner. But his dream is short-lived: his shuttle crashes at the opposite end of his destination. Now stranded on an unknown planet, he must journey through a mysterious world if he ever hopes to reach his long-awaited vacation resort.

On a planet shrouded in mystery, you'll need to observe, adapt, and make use of a stunningly rich fauna and flora to help Cibo reach his vacation resort.

Cibo has a unique ability he can inflate his head: This lets him glide through the air, bounce, wedge himself into cavities, absorb shocks, roll, and move objects. He can also mimic shapes and produce sounds using this power.

games.name: Cronos: The New Dawn - Lazarus
games.summary:
Cronos: Lazarus is a brutal new chapter to the Cronos: The New Dawn story. Step into the boots of the Warden and experience a faster, more aggressive style of combat as you fight to complete a mission the Collective must never uncover.

Return to the wastelands of New Dawn as the once-loyal Pathfinder in the process of transforming into the Warden you know and love from the base game. Isolated in the Terminal and severed from the Collective, he devotes every waking moment to awakening a lost Essence he refuses to let fade.

Your sanctuary, however, has been compromised. A new kind of hunter has been deployed with one directive: to find and eliminate you.

games.name: Crushed in Time
games.summary:
Just as the new Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson video game hit the market, one of its characters mysteriously went missing.

After their memorable appearance in the non-game There Is No Game: Wrong Dimension, our extravagant investigators are back in their own adventure. Armed with their iconic ineptitude, they must solve a mystery that transcends the space-time boundaries of their world... But they won’t succeed without your help!

Travel to the very heart of the game's creation and explore the various stages of its development to unravel the threads of this strange case.

games.name: Cthulhu Mythos ADV Lunatic Whispers & The Isle Of Ubohoth
games.summary:
This adventure game revolves around abilities and dice rolls, driving the story forward. Experience two titles in one.

Lunatic Whispers: 

You awaken to a strange, abandoned hospital. Your memories become muddled, and a mysterious voice echoes in your head. In this place, where inexplicable events occur, you must maintain your sanity and uncover the truth.

Will you be able to escape with your companions and free yourself from karma?

The Isle Of Ubohoth:

An island in the Seto Inland Sea. There's an urban legend that if you complete the "88 Temple Pilgrimage," Kukai will appear and grant your wish. Upon visiting the island, the protagonist is cursed, putting his life in danger.

On this beautiful island, you'll forge bonds with your companions, solve mysteries, and confront ancient customs and curses.

games.name: Curse of the Crimson Stag
games.summary:
Brit, a teenager feeling left behind in her backwater hometown, lands a ghost-hunting job at the secluded Timberline Hotel. She hopes to capture footage that will make her famous. But when her employer is hospitalized, Brit must handle the investigation alone.

As she arrives at the desolate, crumbling estate, Brit quickly realizes there are more dangerous forces at play than any supernatural entity.

Equipped with her camera and an array of ghost-hunting gear, she descends into the hotel's shadowy corridors, determined to uncover its secrets. However, her investigation takes an unexpected turn as she discovers a web of unsettling clues hinting at a far more sinister truth hidden within the hotel's history that has never been told before.

games.name: Cute 'em Up Collection
games.summary:
Includes Exo-Calibre + Takotan in one sexy collection!

In Exo-Calibre, meet the Ex-Calibre Knights, elite pilots in state-of-the-art exo-mechs, defending peace, justice and hope across the world! 

Take flight as one of 3 pilots, each with unique shot types and melee weapons, and engage in vertical scrolling shoot’em up combat against swarms of automaton enemies. Take down screen-filling bosses and chase high scores, earning bonuses for maintaining high health and not losing lives along the way. 

In Takotan, the world has been taken over by an alien invasion. On the eve of destruction, humanity calls out for help! 

Save the world from alien invasion by shooting and dodging your way through 8 action-packed levels with sinister bosses! Collect a variety of power-ups including lasers, bowling balls and ninja stars to take down enemies and defend the planet.

games.name: Cutout Village
games.summary: Build your own little paper village in this relaxing city-builder focused on building and crafting. Cut, fold and glue to help it grow, discover its story and join its inhabitants as they slowly bring life back to its streets.

games.name: Dark Mass
games.summary:
Dark Mass is a first-person psychological horror game that immerses you in the eerie silence of the deep ocean, where time stands still and forgotten horrors await. 

Play as Alice, a deep-sea explorer who, alongside her brother Reed, discovers the remains of a shipwreck unearthed after an earthquake. But beneath the wreckage lies something far more disturbing: a sunken manor, untouched despite the passing of centuries, waiting to be discovered.

Venturing inside, Alice soon realizes she isn't alone. An implacable presence lurks in the shadows, bound to the manor by a dark curse.

To escape, Alice must uncover its tragic past, solve puzzles based on real historical torture rituals, and make moral decisions that define her fate.

games.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
games.summary:
Deep Dish Dungeon is a dungeon crawler and exploration game that rewards curiosity and resourcefulness. In an atmospheric environment, explore corridors, rooms and passageways solo or with up to two friends, and gather resources to improve your camping site. Craft tools and cook nourishing meals to bolster strength throughout the journey, and unravel the enigma that lies within the shadows.

Forage and scavenge as you traverse through the dungeon's bountiful depths. Between your journeys, return to camp and plan your next steps by the fire. Use the resources you find to craft new tools and cook a hearty meal. Remember that food is progress: over time, unlock recipes that have different effects on your stats.

Fortune favors the bold. Take your time to investigate every shadow, solve every puzzle, and open every door. The dungeon will reveal its secrets only if you are patient and persistent. Learn how to defeat enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and never take a hint for granted.

games.name: Demonschool
games.summary:
Demonschool is a new-style tactics RPG where motion equals action. Defeat big weirdos in between the human and demon worlds as Faye and her misfit companions, while navigating university life on a mysterious island.

Plan your team's schedule to enhance their skills and gain new abilities. Gain new teammates and enhance their relationships depending on who you choose to pursue.

games.name: Dice Gambit
games.summary: Shape and lead your own fully customisable (and debt-ridden) family of Inquisitors in charge of hunting the chromatic monsters infesting the city. Unlock unique abilities, hang out with eccentric nobles, learn the secrets the city holds while occasionally delivering ice cream!

games.name: Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099
games.summary:
The Primate Observation Club is still active and stronger than ever in the year 2099. The world has become a hilariously absurd, retro-futuristic dystopia where spying is even more amusing! 

Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099 is a digital voyeur simulator that combines narrative, investigation, surveillance, and resource management.

games.name: Dodo Duckie!
games.summary:
You’re a DUCK! with one special cap that gives you the power to switch between 2D and 3D. 

Use it to explore, switch perspectives, solve puzzles and save your chicken friends.

games.name: Don't Kill Them All
games.summary:
Don't Kill Them All is a turn-based strategy and base-building game in which you teach Orcs to develop mindfulness by discovering passions, navigating emotions, and developing healthy relationships.

Skulls pile up, but the coffers are empty. Blinded by their constant destructive urges, the Orcs leave nothing standing in their wake. A simple raid for wood resources quickly turns into a massacre and clear-cutting. Something has to change, and fast.

As a Half-Orc raised by Elves, your goal is to help the Orcs out of their plight. They're family, after all!

games.name: DriveCrazy
games.summary:
NEWS: To celebrate the release of Zombie Arcade LITE we are slashing the price of Zombie Arcade (for a limited time only) - get it before the undead get you!

COMING SOON: High-dying antics in a new airport level!

The zombies are coming, just like you always said they would. You have been training for this moment for your entire life. Are you up to the challenge?

Zombie Arcade is a 3D arcade-style shoot 'em up, with full physics ragdolls, crisp high quality sound effects, a rockin' soundtrack and a weapons arsenal that may just include the kitchen sink!

Zombie Arcade gives you:

* Your own customisable Apartment
* Your own Zombie T-Shirt Collection (with Apartment display frame)
* Unlockable weapons, trophies and t-shirts  (using OpenFeint™)
* 3D Trophy Cabinet
* A 9mm pistol and four (4) more unlockable weapons
* High-quality super-realistic sound effects
* Two modes of gameplay
* Four fully-mapped and rendered zombie-slaying locations (and more on the way!)
* Ten (10) grades of difficulty to challenge ALL zombie-hunters
* OpenFeint™ leaderboards to show off your undead mastery
* A killer zombie-whacking MP3 soundtrack
* Countless references to zom-coms, undead action flicks and anything George A. Romero

Game Modes:

* INVASION - take out the zombies before they get to you! Use your weaponry, touch and timing well. You will have to balance the hoard of incoming flesh-eaters while reloading, firing and laughing with glee...

* SURVIVING BOREDOM - in all zombie movies there's that scene where everyone is finding some way to keep themselves entertained.  If only they had Zombie Arcade! Being safe away from zombies means you can use them as target practice - take them out with a chip shot or perhaps a large calibre slug...

Weapons:

* The 9mm Pistol  - small but effective...
* The Magnum - the largest, most powerful hand-cannon that money (or post-apocalyptic looting) can buy...
* The Golf Club - take out zombies with a powerful drive to the head!
* The Record Collection - is this the second album you ever bought? Who cares! Throw it anyway!
* The Shotgun - the zombie-hunter's weapon of choice. There just couldn't be a Zombie Arcade without one.

This is a Zombiephile's delight! If you have ever been down at the local video store, torn between your favourite zom-com and that hot new zombie action flick, THIS is for you.

Zombie Arcade - It's an apocalypse in your pocket!

Note: This app is presently NOT compatible with iPad.

games.name: Dumb Ways to Party
games.summary:
Dumb Ways to Party throws contestants into the The Dumbest of the Dumb game show - a whirlwind of wacky challenges, hilarious mishaps, surprise twists, big wins and even bigger fails!

The challenge? Out-dumb the competition and take home the prestigious title of Dumbest of the Dumb!

Are you here for glory? Fame? Or just to make a fool of yourself? Let’s find out!

games.name: Dungeons of DUSK
games.summary:
Dungeons of DUSK is a classic turn based dungeon crawling RPG that takes place canonically between the episodes of the cult classic FPS.

Are you... WORTHY?
