games.summary:
From the creators of the worldwide sensation OVERCOOKED! comes “Stage Fright”, an all new co-operative experience for 2 players. Take your friend on an amazing adventure as you explore, solve escape rooms, overcome fiendish obstacles and unravel an ancient mystery.

Stage Fright is built from the ground up as a co-operative experience, bursting with Overcooked-style chaotic moments and escape room-esque co-operation. Play online or better still, side-by-side.

Guide Drew, Blake and Charlie through a charming coming-of-age story with real heart and memorable characters. Switch between pairs of kids as the story unravels from two unique perspectives.

games.name: Star Trek: Shadow Frontier
games.summary:
Star Trek: Shadow Frontier is a mature, story-driven, 3rd person action-adventure set in the expansive Star Trek universe. After crashing onto a distant planet overtaken by a strange consciousness, Ro Laren must survive in an environment that is as breathtaking as it is lethal.

In true Star Trek fashion, Ro’s mission is driven by duty and purpose. But here, discovery comes at a terrible cost. The more she uncovers, the deeper she is pulled into a corrupted labyrinth where her memories twist and the planet threatens to sever her connection to reality.

Only by solving the mysteries of this strange world can Ro hope to make peace with the demons of her past, boldly going into the heart of darkness like never before.

games.name: The Detectorist Guild
games.summary:
A cosy village-life RPG set in Yorkshire, England, in 1999. 

Follow James as he explores a quintessential British village with his metal detector, uncovering lost treasures and slowly unravelling a dark mystery that draws him and his family into its depths.

games.name: The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes
games.summary:
Lurk in the shadows and hunt the shadows.

The Eminence in Shadow comes to home consoles for the first time!

Challenge the powerful opponents that stand in your way in this roguelite action game.

games.name: The Escapists 3
games.summary: Plan ridiculous prison breaks, outsmart the guards and escape your way in The Escapists 3. Craft, sneak, fight and improvise through a new 3D prison sandbox, alone or with friends. Just remember to make roll call.

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
games.summary:
Geralt of Rivia returns to the Path in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past, a brand-new expansion to one of the best-selling role-playing games of all time. 

With enhancements to visuals, performance, gameplay, and more through the Remastered upgrade, the idyllic land of Letten is yours to explore. But a dark secret lurks beneath the surface, and Geralt must overcome never-before-seen foes as he fights to overcome its long-dormant evil.

More than his life is at stake though; across a story filled with choices and consequences, the fate of the entire land, and even Geralt’s closest friendship, are also at risk.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us 2
games.summary:
Fairytale characters are real and walk among us.

Play as Bigby, “The Big Bad Wolf” and Sheriff of Fabletown, as you return to a gritty detective noir world where there are no fairy tale endings.

games.name: Trivia Murder Party 3
games.summary:
Pack your sleeping bag and prepare to fight for your life. Trivia Murder Party 3 is here to help you make memories that will last a lifetime. 

In this standalone entry in the Trivia Murder Party series, players must survive a sadistic summer hosted by a mysterious killer with a flair for drama and deadly consequences.

games.name: UN:Me
games.summary:
A girl awakens in a mysterious labyrinth. Four voices echo within her mind. 

They are human "souls" drifting through this maze. Each of the four souls seeks to fulfill their own desires, attempting to seize control of the girl's body and act on their own will.

What are these four souls, truly? Who created this enigmatic labyrinth - and why? Who is this girl?

UN:Me is an adventure game where you guide a girl harboring multiple souls within her body through an unsettling mental labyrinth, engaging in dialogue with each soul while making the harrowing choice of which to keep and which to erase in your escape attempt.

(Grow more plants, they can absorb poops...)You are the creator in mysterious biochemistry lab! From trilobite of Cambrian Period to dinosaur of Cretaceous Period, and saber-toothed tiger of Kainozoic era, you can create any species you want. All kinds of mysterious liquid medicines and magic mushrooms will help you to finish final evolution.

Welcome to Brightville
games.summary:
'Welcome to Brightville' is an action-adventure immersive sim in which you play as a unique automaton guardian. You will explore the mysterious city of Brightville, where magic and steampunk technology collide!

Navigate a world where magic and technology collide! Experiment with abilities, interact with characters, and adapt to an environment that responds to your decisions. 

Whether you engage in combat, explore the city's hidden depths, or uncover the mysteries of your existence, every action shapes the world around you.

games.name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Rageborn
games.summary:
What can two students do in the face of the apocalypse?

When his eco-activist friend is gunned down before his eyes, Taylor’s true nature is revealed in a tsunami of blood. He becomes a monster, a werewolf – a champion of the Earth. Thus begins a quest for vengeance and identity across the wild expanses of Alaska.

Howl at the Moon. Tear Gaia’s enemies apart. Avenge a dying world. That is what you can do.

games.name: Worms: Galactic Tactics
games.summary:
Worms: Galactic Tactics brings the weapons, comedy and destructive chaos of Worms to a bold new battlefield.

Gear up a custom squad and take on the Galactic Gauntlet: a multi-stage deathmatch where every battle brings new enemies, potent upgrades and fresh opportunities to cause mayhem!

Plan your moves, power-up your weapons and wow the crowd as you climb the ranks, with the ultimate goal of facing down the gauntlet's ruthless kingpin: the magnificent Emperor Flugg!

games.name: You Are Family
games.summary:
Live an adventure where you were just looking for a quiet break... and end up fighting for your own survival.

You Are Family is a first-person graphic adventure with a unique, one-of-a-kind visual style: all graphics are captured directly with a real Game Boy Camera. Authentic pixels, mixed with that gritty, magical aesthetic that only the original hardware can deliver.

With the soul of a B-movie, horror and humor blend without restraint while you solve puzzles, investigate clues, and fight to survive. What is happening? The answer awaits you within those walls.
